headline: A 1994 executive order on how federal agencies lead and coordinate fair housing efforts in their programs.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order deals with how the federal government leads and coordinates fair housing work across its programs. It focuses on "affirmatively furthering fair housing," a term from federal fair housing law about agencies taking active steps to support fair housing in the programs they run. No summary was provided, so the specific rules and duties in the order cannot be confirmed here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that run housing and community development programs
who_it_affects.how: The order appears to set expectations for how these agencies handle fair housing and work together on it.

who_it_affects.group: People who live in or apply for housing connected to federal programs
who_it_affects.how: The order may affect how fair housing is considered in the programs that serve them, though the details are not stated in the title.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 17, 1994; no separate start date is given in the available information.
